title: Membership in the perpendicular subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $ bf_2$, and let $gamma$ be a vector in that space. Then $gamma$ lies in the perpendicular subspace to $A$ if and only if its dot product with every vector in $A$ is zero.
